rubric: Allow equivalent LaTeX, grouping, fonts, spacing, alignment and cosmetic punctuation. Require the same math symbols, operations, scripts, bounds, delimiters, equation rows and matrix entries. Record false presentation wrappers separately.

syntax.renderer: Bundled KaTeX 0.19.1, display mode and throwOnError enabled

wikipedia.fractions-01: Turns the mixed number 12 3/4 into a power.
wikipedia.fractions-08: Drops cancellation marks, adds primes to struck factors and omits three replacement ones.
wikipedia.roots-10: Omits one fraction level from each continued fraction.
wikipedia.aligned-10: Changes the first integrand from a second derivative to a first derivative.
wikipedia.small-type-03: Adds a parallel superscript to the outer single-row array.
wikipedia.small-type-04: Adds a double vertical bar in a superscript.

hefferon-pdf.hefferon-02: Returns only the second of three equations.
hefferon-pdf.hefferon-04: Returns only the second of four equations.

additional_rejection.aligned-10: Changes the first integrand from a second derivative to a first derivative. The frozen crop shows two primes.

plus_l_additional_notes.aligned-01: Uses a right-aligned array for the two derivation lines and adds a terminal period.
plus_l_additional_notes.aligned-03: Moves the alignment to the start of the lines and adds a trailing row separator. KaTeX renders the two intended rows.

timing_context.scope: Observational worker timing. The trial app stayed available for user input. No physical mouse-up-to-clipboard measurement.
